title: Choose Supper Club AI’s visual world
question: The lead direction treats dinner planning like producing a live community-radio broadcast. Keep it, choose another world, play it straight, or re-roll.

options.label: The Community Broadcast
options.lineage: Black community radio studios, jazz program logs, and live producer rundowns
options.thesis: The dinner becomes a live cultural broadcast whose courses, tracks, stories, and host tasks share one timed rundown.
options.viewport: A dense but warm desktop rundown places Seed & Stars on a central evening timeline, with the editable plan at left and ChatGPT’s latest tool receipts in a narrow live producer rail at right.
options.risk: The broadcast metaphor can feel technical unless food, guests, and hospitality remain more prominent than studio language.

raised.raise: One live signal carries the accent color while the rest of the workspace stays calm enough for dense planning.
Every confirmed choice remains visibly connected to the earlier draft it transformed from.
A single synchronized evening clock governs courses, music, prep, and host cues.

options.label: The Speculative Salon Ledger
options.lineage: Black literary salons, independent arts journals, and an event producer’s annotated run-of-show
options.thesis: A living editorial folio turns the host’s cultural thesis into a dinner plan guests can experience scene by scene.
options.viewport: An asymmetric magazine spread opens on Seed & Stars, with the evening thesis and sequence commanding the page while recipes, wine, reading, and music sit in annotated editorial columns.
options.risk: This is the most naturally tasteful direction and therefore the one most likely to resemble other premium editorial products.

options.label: The Select Rail
options.lineage: film cutting benches and perforated work prints
options.thesis: The evening is edited as a strip of scenes, with every kept, deferred, or replaced choice marked directly on the work print.
options.viewport: A perforated sequence rail crosses the planner at a fixed height; courses and cultural beats occupy frames while unused ideas hang below as reachable trims.
options.case: Product clarity is excellent because planning already resembles editing, but a Creative Host identifies less strongly with a cutting room than a gathering.
options.risk: The severe orange-and-black bench can overpower the warmth and cultural specificity of the dinner.

options.label: The Host’s Card Stack
options.lineage: HyperCard stacks and hand-authored digital shoeboxes
options.thesis: Books, dishes, bottles, and songs are editable cards the host can browse, connect, and rewrite in place.
options.viewport: A fixed-proportion Seed & Stars card opens in the center with visible stack navigation, editable fields, and linked cards for menu, reading, wine, music, and shopping.
options.case: Its authoring model makes WebMCP edits unusually legible, but the nostalgic computer identity says maker before it says host.
options.risk: The one-bit interface can become retro novelty and makes food, wine, and atmosphere visually austere.

options.label: The Evening Atlas
options.lineage: celestial atlas plates and coordinate charts
options.thesis: Each dinner element becomes a plotted body whose size shows importance and whose lines reveal the evening’s cultural connections.
options.viewport: Seed & Stars appears as a navigable constellation of courses, readings, tracks, and prep milestones, with the selected object opening as an editable planning plate.
options.case: It strongly signals the featured Afrofuturist theme, but a constellation is a weaker planning model and risks reducing Afrofuturism to outer-space decoration.
options.risk: The signature theme could trap future dinners in the same cosmic visual language.

options.label: The Cultural Prospectus
options.thesis: The host’s evening reads as a polished cultural proposal with one luminous thread connecting every decision.
options.viewport: A bright prospectus introduces Seed & Stars beside a responsive ribbon, followed by clean bands for the menu, reading, music, wine, and event console.
options.case: It is polished but identifies a civic or enterprise buyer, and its hero structure obscures the operating workspace.
options.risk: The result would look accomplished yet interchangeable with a contemporary AI SaaS product.
options.kept: Spend the strongest color on one live signal instead of distributing accents everywhere.

options.label: The Folded Evening
options.thesis: One unbroken plan transforms through deliberate stages until menu, guests, timing, and atmosphere lock into a finished gathering.
options.viewport: A centered plan sheet shows the current transformation beside a strict numbered sequence for theme, menu, pairings, shopping, prep, and export.
options.case: The transformation story is elegant, but folding language is remote from cultural hosting and weakens scanning across parallel tasks.
options.risk: A linear craft tutorial cannot comfortably hold the planner’s dense, revisable network of decisions.
options.kept: Show how each confirmed state preserves the history of the draft it came from.

options.label: The Dinner Descent
options.lineage: technical dive profiles and mesophotic field notes
options.thesis: The host descends through preparation toward the dinner, with every choice pinned to an exact time and depth of commitment.
options.viewport: A vertical profile links research, shopping, prep, service, and follow-up while close-view panels reveal recipes, pairings, and cultural notes.
options.case: Its synchronized timeline is useful, but both the audience signal and dinner-planning model depend on an unrelated expedition metaphor.
options.risk: The journey becomes visually dramatic while the food and gathering become secondary annotations.
options.kept: Make one synchronized time axis control every dependent plan surface.

canonCard.label: The Premium Planner
canonCard.thesis: A polished card-based planning dashboard makes every ingredient, recommendation, and action familiar on first use.
canonCard.viewport: A left navigation, centered plan board, and right activity panel organize Seed & Stars into conventional dashboard cards.
canonCard.risk: It is easy to understand because it resembles every premium lifestyle planning product.
